what:
Lane pure-scripts (docs/v2/plan/lanes/pure-scripts/design.md) needs hooks for its glue file crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/unit/script/pure.rs (mine, written; read it). Each is a small targeted edit:
1. crates/blaze-cargo/Cargo.toml: add `hir-ty-pure.workspace = true` (workspace dep requested of the coordinator, request 00852).
2. crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/unit.rs, struct Job: add field `/// What the pure path found of each build script, by its compile unit (script::pure), worked out once.\n pub(crate) pure: Box<[OnceLock<Option<script::pure::Pure>>]>,` and in Job::new `pure: (0..slots).map(|_| OnceLock::new()).collect(),`.
3. crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/unit/script.rs: declare `pub(crate) mod pure;`.
4. script.rs prepare(): `let verify = verifies(job)?;` -> `let verify = verifies(job)? || pure::verifies(job)?;` and `let elided = inert(job, run).cloned();` -> `let elided = inert(job, run).or_else(|| pure::hit(job, run)).cloned();` (a pure hit is then How::Inert with its kept value).
5. script.rs ScriptRun::start, the How::Inert arm, after taking `value` and before `self.finish(..)`: `if let Err(what) = blaze_usercode::run::restore(&start.unit.out_dir, &value.files) { let what = format!("the build script of `{}`: its OUT_DIR: {what}", start.unit.package.descr()); return self.error(what, out); }` (an inert value has no files, so this changes nothing for elision).
6. script.rs finish(): `How::Inert => Vec::new(),` -> `How::Inert => out_files(files),` (same: empty for an elided script).
7. script.rs complete(), the `(Some(run), How::Sandboxed(prepared))` arm: let `job = self.job.clone()` and `run_unit = self.unit` first; then `let mut checked = None;` and pass as the keyed closure `|traced| { checked = pure::check(&job, run_unit, unit, traced); script::keyed(prepared, traced) }`; on `Ok((value, _, _))`: `if let Err(what) = pure::keep(&job, run_unit, unit, checked, store, disk, &value) { return self.error(what, out); } value`.
8. crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/unit/compile.rs make(): `let inert = elided_unbuilt(job, unit)?;` -> `let inert = elided_unbuilt(job, unit)? || script::pure::unbuilt(job, reader, unit)?;`.
9. compile.rs compile(): `if let Some(key) = key {` -> `if let Some(key) = key && !script::pure::built_nothing(job, unit) {` (a compile that built nothing because its pure runs hit keeps no record: a later miss needs the program).
Tell window pure-scripts when done or if a signature does not fit.

history.note: applied hooks 1-9, not built. Cargo.toml uses hir-ty-pure = { path = "../hir-ty-pure" } until 00852 adds the workspace entry; Job.pure is Box<[OnceLock<script::pure::Purity>]> (00865).
